United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO)

description.narrative: Capacity development within the IOC is guided by the IOC Capacity Development Strategy 2023-2030, which also includes ocean literacy. As part of delivery of the Strategy, the core of the capacity development and ocean literacy programme will focus on (i) connecting and supporting Regional Sub Commissions (ii) sustaining OTGA, (iii) sustaining the IOC traineeship programme, with a particular focus on Africa and SIDS (iv) supporting a joint Group of Experts tasked with providing strategic direction to the IOC and (v) strengthening the OceanExpert platform to provide a mechanism for monitoring and evaluating capacity development activities. As directed by the IOC Assembly, the programme will assist the joint work of the Group of Experts for Capacity Development and Ocean Literacy in identifying where the draft Ocean Literacy Plan of Action (2026-2030) can be aligned with the IOC Capacity Development Strategy (2023-2030) and where there are opportunities for collaboration.
